headline: Possible executive session, if the town attorney recommends it, plus a correspondence summary.
summary: The agenda lists a summary of correspondence received since the last update. A confidential session is also listed, and an executive session may be held if the town attorney recommends one.
items: Summary of correspondence since the last update
Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
location: Hamden Government Center, 2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518 (in person), or via Zoom

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
BOARD OF ETHICS 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
7:00 PM, NOVEMBER 10, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Board of Ethics, Town of Hamden, will hold a Regular Meeting on 
Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 7:00 PM via zoom or in-person at the Hamden 
Government Center.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
  1. Approval of the minutes from the October 13th meeting. 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.  
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
7. Confidential Session 
 
8. REPORTS 
 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
 
10. NEW BUSINESS 
 
11. ADJOURNMENT
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
